يرتقيان (form VIII)
# يَرْتَقِيَانِ (yartaqiyāni) /jar.ta.qi.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
# يُرْتَقَيَانِ (yurtaqayāni) /jur.ta.qa.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَقَى (irtaqā)
